key_impacts: Nuclear fuel melted inside the reactors following the accident
Coolant water became extremely contaminated and leaked into the reactor building basements
Approximately 400 tons of groundwater flowed into the site daily, adding to contaminated water volumes
The site became packed with numerous 1,000-ton capacity tanks storing contaminated water
